description:
Inside the Green Room brings you NBA reactions, debates, and stories from three-time NBA champion Danny Green and ESPN Radio, MSG Networks & NBATV host Harrison Sanford.

Danny takes you beyond the box score with firsthand perspective from championship locker rooms and life around the league. From breaking NBA news and postgame takeaways to Top 5 debates and stories from the road, expect honest opinions, basketball insight, and plenty of laughs.

Watch LIVE Mondays and Thursdays at 11 PM ET / 8 PM PT. Join the chat and bring your questions.

Subscribe for full episodes, standalone segments, an
